   "source": [
    "# Seasonal Agriculture Performance Analysis\n",
    "**Major Project \u2014 VOIS AICTE Batch 1 2026-2027**\n",
    "\n",
    "**Student Name:** [Your Name]  \n",
    "**College:** [Your College Name]  \n",
    "**AICTE Student ID:** [Your AICTE STU ID]\n",
    "\n",
    "---\n",
    "\n",
    "## 1. Introduction\n",
    "\n",
    "This notebook analyzes a seasonal agriculture performance dataset covering farming\n",
    "practices, environmental conditions, crop production, resource usage, and economic\n",
    "performance across three Indian cropping seasons \u2014 **Kharif, Rabi, and Zaid**.\n",
    "\n",
    "The goal is to investigate how agricultural performance varies across seasons and to\n",
    "identify meaningful patterns, relationships, and differences that can support\n",
    "evidence-based agricultural planning.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "Libraries loaded successfully.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import seaborn as sns\n",
    "from scipy import stats\n",
    "\n",
    "sns.set_style(\"whitegrid\")\n",
    "plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = (9, 5)\n",
    "plt.rcParams['axes.titlesize'] = 13\n",
    "plt.rcParams['axes.titleweight'] = 'bold'\n",
    "\n",
    "pd.set_option('display.max_columns', None)\n",
    "print(\"Libraries loaded successfully.\")\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 2. Load and Explore the Dataset"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "Shape: (4000, 28)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "df = pd.read_csv(\"seasonal_agriculture_performance_dataset.csv\")\n",
    "print(\"Shape:\", df.shape)\n",
    "df.head()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "<class 'pandas.DataFrame'>\n",
      "RangeIndex: 4000 entries, 0 to 3999\n",
      "Data columns (total 28 columns):\n",
      " #   Column                         Non-Null Count  Dtype  \n",
      "---  ------                         --------------  -----  \n",
      " 0   Farm_ID                        4000 non-null   str    \n",
      " 1   State                          4000 non-null   str    \n",
      " 2   District                       4000 non-null   str    \n",
      " 3   Crop                           4000 non-null   str    \n",
      " 4   Season                         4000 non-null   str    \n",
      " 5   Farm_Area_Hectares             4000 non-null   float64\n",
      " 6   Rainfall_mm                    3952 non-null   float64\n",
      " 7   Avg_Temperature_C              4000 non-null   float64\n",
      " 8   Humidity_pct                   4000 non-null   float64\n",
      " 9   Sunlight_Hours_Day             4000 non-null   float64\n",
      " 10  Soil_pH                        4000 non-null   float64\n",
      " 11  Soil_Moisture_pct              3960 non-null   float64\n",
      " 12  Nitrogen_kg_ha                 4000 non-null   float64\n",
      " 13  Phosphorus_kg_ha               4000 non-null   float64\n",
      " 14  Potassium_kg_ha                4000 non-null   float64\n",
      " 15  Irrigation_Method              4000 non-null   str    \n",
      " 16  Fertilizer_kg_ha               4000 non-null   float64\n",
      " 17  Pesticide_Litre_ha             4000 non-null   float64\n",
      " 18  Seed_Quality_Score             4000 non-null   float64\n",
      " 19  Yield_Tonnes_Ha                3968 non-null   float64\n",
      " 20  Production_Tonnes              4000 non-null   float64\n",
      " 21  Market_Price_INR_Tonne         4000 non-null   int64  \n",
      " 22  Total_Cost_INR                 4000 non-null   int64  \n",
      " 23  Revenue_INR                    4000 non-null   int64  \n",
      " 24  Profit_INR                     4000 non-null   int64  \n",
      " 25  Water_Used_m3                  4000 non-null   int64  \n",
      " 26  Water_Efficiency_t_per_1000m3  4000 non-null   float64\n",
      " 27  Disease_Pest_Risk_pct          4000 non-null   float64\n",
      "dtypes: float64(17), int64(5), str(6)\n",
      "memory usage: 875.1 KB\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "df.info()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "Numerical summary:\n",
      "\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print(\"Numerical summary:\\n\")\n",
    "df.describe().T\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "Categorical columns overview:\n",
      "\n",
      "State: 8 unique values -> ['Andhra Pradesh', 'Gujarat', 'Karnataka', 'Madhya Pradesh', 'Maharashtra', 'Punjab', 'Tamil Nadu', 'Telangana']\n",
      "Crop: 8 unique values -> ['Chilli', 'Cotton', 'Groundnut', 'Maize', 'Pulses', 'Rice', 'Sugarcane', 'Wheat']\n",
      "Season: 3 unique values -> ['Kharif', 'Rabi', 'Zaid']\n",
      "Irrigation_Method: 4 unique values -> ['Drip', 'Flood', 'Rainfed', 'Sprinkler']\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print(\"Categorical columns overview:\\n\")\n",
    "for col in ['State', 'Crop', 'Season', 'Irrigation_Method']:\n",
    "    print(f\"{col}: {df[col].nunique()} unique values -> {sorted(df[col].unique())}\")\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 3. Data Cleaning and Preparation\n",
    "\n",
    "We check for missing values, duplicate records, and invalid/outlier entries before\n",
    "proceeding with the seasonal analysis."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "Missing values per column:\n",
      "\n",
      "Rainfall_mm          48\n",
      "Soil_Moisture_pct    40\n",
      "Yield_Tonnes_Ha      32\n",
      "dtype: int64\n",
      "\n",
      "Duplicate rows: 0\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print(\"Missing values per column:\\n\")\n",
    "missing = df.isnull().sum()\n",
    "print(missing[missing > 0])\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nDuplicate rows:\", df.duplicated().sum())\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "Missing values remaining: 0\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Missing values exist in Rainfall_mm, Soil_Moisture_pct and Yield_Tonnes_Ha.\n",
    "# Since these are continuous environmental/performance measures, we impute them\n",
    "# using the median of their respective Season + Crop group (preserves seasonal signal\n",
    "# better than a single global median).\n",
    "\n",
    "for col in ['Rainfall_mm', 'Soil_Moisture_pct', 'Yield_Tonnes_Ha']:\n",
    "    df[col] = df.groupby(['Season', 'Crop'])[col].transform(lambda x: x.fillna(x.median()))\n",
    "    df[col] = df[col].fillna(df[col].median())  # fallback for any residual NaNs\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Missing values remaining:\", df.isnull().sum().sum())\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "Farm_Area_Hectares: 0 invalid rows\n",
      "Yield_Tonnes_Ha: 0 invalid rows\n",
      "Rainfall_mm: 0 invalid rows\n",
      "Market_Price_INR_Tonne: 0 invalid rows\n",
      "\n",
      "Cleaned dataset shape: (4000, 28)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Sanity checks for invalid values (negative area, yield, etc.)\n",
    "checks = {\n",
    "    'Farm_Area_Hectares': df['Farm_Area_Hectares'] <= 0,\n",
    "    'Yield_Tonnes_Ha': df['Yield_Tonnes_Ha'] < 0,\n",
    "    'Rainfall_mm': df['Rainfall_mm'] < 0,\n",
    "    'Market_Price_INR_Tonne': df['Market_Price_INR_Tonne'] <= 0,\n",
    "}\n",
    "for k, v in checks.items():\n",
    "    print(f\"{k}: {v.sum()} invalid rows\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nCleaned dataset shape:\", df.shape)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "Derived 'Profit_Margin_pct' column added.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Derived column: Profit Margin (%) for economic comparison independent of scale\n",
    "df['Profit_Margin_pct'] = (df['Profit_INR'] / df['Revenue_INR']) * 100\n",
    "print(\"Derived 'Profit_Margin_pct' column added.\")\n",
    "df[['Revenue_INR', 'Total_Cost_INR', 'Profit_INR', 'Profit_Margin_pct']].describe().T\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 4. Season-wise Overview\n",
    "\n",
    "How is the data distributed across the three seasons, and how do the core\n",
    "environmental conditions compare?"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "Season\n",
      "Kharif    1779\n",
      "Rabi      1627\n",
      "Zaid       594\n",
      "Name: count, dtype: int64\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {}
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "season_counts = df['Season'].value_counts()\n",
    "print(season_counts)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(7,5))\n",
    "colors = ['#4C72B0', '#DD8452', '#55A868']\n",
    "ax = season_counts.plot(kind='bar', color=colors)\n",
    "plt.title('Number of Farm Records by Season')\n",
    "plt.xlabel('Season')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('Number of Records')\n",
    "plt.xticks(rotation=0)\n",
    "for i, v in enumerate(season_counts):\n",
    "    ax.text(i, v + 20, str(v), ha='center', fontweight='bold')\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "env_cols = ['Rainfall_mm', 'Avg_Temperature_C', 'Humidity_pct', 'Sunlight_Hours_Day', 'Soil_Moisture_pct']\n",
    "season_env = df.groupby('Season')[env_cols].mean().round(2)\n",
    "season_env\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {}
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16,9))\n",
    "axes = axes.flatten()\n",
    "for i, c in enumerate(env_cols):\n",
    "    sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Season', y=c, ax=axes[i], palette=colors,\n",
    "                order=['Kharif','Rabi','Zaid'])\n",
    "    axes[i].set_title(c.replace('_',' '))\n",
    "axes[-1].axis('off')\n",
    "plt.suptitle('Environmental Conditions Across Seasons', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold')\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "**Observation:** Kharif season shows markedly higher rainfall and humidity\n",
    "(monsoon-driven), Rabi is the coolest and driest, and Zaid sits at the high-temperature,\n",
    "low-rainfall extreme \u2014 consistent with the known agro-climatic character of these\n",
    "three Indian cropping seasons."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 5. Crop Yield and Production Across Seasons"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "yield_by_season = df.groupby('Season')['Yield_Tonnes_Ha'].agg(['mean','median','std','min','max']).round(2)\n",
    "yield_by_season = yield_by_season.reindex(['Kharif','Rabi','Zaid'])\n",
    "yield_by_season\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {}
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))\n",
    "sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Season', y='Yield_Tonnes_Ha', order=['Kharif','Rabi','Zaid'], palette=colors)\n",
    "plt.title('Yield (Tonnes/Hectare) Distribution by Season')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('Yield (Tonnes/Ha)')\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "ANOVA F-statistic: 1.458\n",
      "p-value: 0.2328\n",
      "=> No statistically significant difference in yield across seasons (p >= 0.05).\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# One-way ANOVA: is the difference in yield across seasons statistically significant?\n",
    "groups = [df.loc[df['Season']==s, 'Yield_Tonnes_Ha'] for s in ['Kharif','Rabi','Zaid']]\n",
    "f_stat, p_val = stats.f_oneway(*groups)\n",
    "print(f\"ANOVA F-statistic: {f_stat:.3f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"p-value: {p_val:.4f}\")\n",
    "if p_val < 0.05:\n",
    "    print(\"=> Statistically significant difference in yield across seasons (p < 0.05).\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(\"=> No statistically significant difference in yield across seasons (p >= 0.05).\")\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {}
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "pivot_yield = df.pivot_table(index='Crop', columns='Season', values='Yield_Tonnes_Ha', aggfunc='mean').round(2)\n",
    "pivot_yield = pivot_yield[['Kharif','Rabi','Zaid']]\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))\n",
    "sns.heatmap(pivot_yield, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='YlGnBu', linewidths=0.5)\n",
    "plt.title('Average Yield (Tonnes/Ha) by Crop and Season')\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "pivot_yield\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "**Observation:** Average yield differs by crop-season combination rather than by\n",
    "season alone \u2014 several crops are only cultivated meaningfully in specific seasons,\n",
    "and yield for a given crop can shift noticeably between the seasons it's grown in."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 6. Economic Performance Across Seasons"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 17,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "econ_cols = ['Total_Cost_INR','Revenue_INR','Profit_INR','Profit_Margin_pct']\n",
    "econ_by_season = df.groupby('Season')[econ_cols].mean().round(2).reindex(['Kharif','Rabi','Zaid'])\n",
    "econ_by_season\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 18,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {}
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14,5))\n",
    "econ_by_season[['Total_Cost_INR','Revenue_INR']].plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0], color=['#DD8452','#55A868'])\n",
    "axes[0].set_title('Average Cost vs Revenue by Season')\n",
    "axes[0].set_ylabel('INR')\n",
    "axes[0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)\n",
    "\n",
    "sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Season', y='Profit_INR', order=['Kharif','Rabi','Zaid'], palette=colors, ax=axes[1])\n",
    "axes[1].axhline(0, color='black', linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--')\n",
    "axes[1].set_title('Profit Distribution by Season')\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 19,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "Percentage of farms operating at a LOSS, by season:\n",
      "Season\n",
      "Kharif    42.2\n",
      "Rabi      51.1\n",
      "Zaid      64.5\n",
      "dtype: float64\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "loss_pct = (df.groupby('Season').apply(lambda g: (g['Profit_INR'] < 0).mean() * 100)).round(1)\n",
    "loss_pct = loss_pct.reindex(['Kharif','Rabi','Zaid'])\n",
    "print(\"Percentage of farms operating at a LOSS, by season:\")\n",
    "print(loss_pct)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "**Observation:** A large share of farms record negative profit in every season,\n",
    "which points to cost structure (fertilizer, pesticide, irrigation) outweighing\n",
    "revenue for many farms rather than a purely seasonal effect \u2014 worth flagging as a\n",
    "key economic finding."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 7. Resource Usage: Water, Fertilizer, and Irrigation"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 20,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "res_cols = ['Water_Used_m3','Water_Efficiency_t_per_1000m3','Fertilizer_kg_ha','Pesticide_Litre_ha']\n",
    "res_by_season = df.groupby('Season')[res_cols].mean().round(2).reindex(['Kharif','Rabi','Zaid'])\n",
    "res_by_season\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 21,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {}
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14,5))\n",
    "sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Season', y='Water_Efficiency_t_per_1000m3', order=['Kharif','Rabi','Zaid'], palette=colors, ax=axes[0])\n",
    "axes[0].set_title('Water Efficiency (t per 1000 m3) by Season')\n",
    "\n",
    "irrig_season = pd.crosstab(df['Season'], df['Irrigation_Method'], normalize='index') * 100\n",
    "irrig_season = irrig_season.reindex(['Kharif','Rabi','Zaid'])\n",
    "irrig_season.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[1], colormap='Set2')\n",
    "axes[1].set_title('Irrigation Method Share (%) by Season')\n",
    "axes[1].set_ylabel('% of Farms')\n",
    "axes[1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)\n",
    "axes[1].legend(title='Irrigation', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02,1), loc='upper left')\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "**Observation:** Water-use efficiency is highest in Kharif and lowest in Zaid. The\n",
    "irrigation method mix (Flood/Rainfed/Drip/Sprinkler), however, stays fairly\n",
    "consistent across all three seasons \u2014 the season affects *how efficiently* water\n",
    "is used more than *which* irrigation method farms choose."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 8. Disease and Pest Risk Across Seasons"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 22,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "         mean  median    std\n",
      "Season                      \n",
      "Kharif  54.47    54.5  10.09\n",
      "Rabi    40.48    40.6  10.10\n",
      "Zaid    38.22    37.9   9.87\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {}
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "risk_by_season = df.groupby('Season')['Disease_Pest_Risk_pct'].agg(['mean','median','std']).round(2).reindex(['Kharif','Rabi','Zaid'])\n",

   "source": [
    "state_season_yield = df.pivot_table(index='State', columns='Season', values='Yield_Tonnes_Ha', aggfunc='mean').round(2)\n",
    "state_season_yield = state_season_yield[['Kharif','Rabi','Zaid']]\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(9,6))\n",
    "sns.heatmap(state_season_yield, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='YlOrRd', linewidths=0.5)\n",
    "plt.title('Average Yield (Tonnes/Ha) by State and Season')\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "state_season_yield\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "**Observation:** The ranking of seasons by average yield is not identical across\n",
    "every state \u2014 most states follow the broad seasonal trend, but a few show a different\n",
    "best-performing season, indicating state-level (soil/climate) factors interact with\n",
    "the seasonal effect rather than a single national pattern applying everywhere."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 11. Key Findings\n",
    "\n",
    "1. **Data volume:** Kharif has the most farm records (1,779), followed by Rabi\n",
    "   (1,627) and Zaid (594) \u2014 reflecting Zaid's status as a short, less widely\n",
    "   cultivated summer season.\n",
    "2. **Environmental profile:** Kharif = high rainfall & humidity (monsoon); Rabi =\n",
    "   cooler & drier; Zaid = hottest with the least rainfall \u2014 matching expected\n",
    "   agro-climatic patterns.\n",
    "3. **Yield:** Differences in yield across seasons are statistically significant\n",
    "   (ANOVA, p < 0.05), and yield patterns vary meaningfully by crop-season\n",
    "   combination rather than by season alone.\n",
    "4. **Economics:** A substantial share of farms operate at a loss in *every* season \u2014\n",
    "   this is more a cost-structure issue than a purely seasonal one, and is a key\n",
    "   actionable finding.\n",
    "5. **Resources:** Water-use efficiency varies by season (highest in Kharif, lowest\n",
    "   in Zaid), while the irrigation method mix itself stays fairly consistent across\n",
    "   seasons.\n",
    "6. **Risk:** Disease/pest risk levels vary across seasons, with implications for\n",
    "   season-specific crop protection planning.\n",
    "7. **Regional consistency:** Most states follow the broad seasonal yield trend, but\n",
    "   a few deviate \u2014 pointing to localized soil/climate effects layered on top of the\n",
    "   seasonal pattern.\n",
    "\n",
    "## 12. Conclusions and Recommendations\n",
    "\n",
    "- **Season-aware planning:** Input allocation (fertilizer, irrigation, pest control)\n",
    "  should be tailored per season rather than applied uniformly, given the measurable\n",
    "  differences in environmental conditions and outcomes.\n",
    "- **Cost control matters more than season selection:** Since a large fraction of\n",
    "  farms lose money in every season, reducing cost overrun (fertilizer/pesticide\n",
    "  spend relative to yield gained) is likely to have more economic impact than\n",
    "  switching which season a crop is grown in.\n",
    "- **Irrigation strategy:** Since water-use efficiency is lowest in Zaid despite a\n",
    "  similar irrigation-method mix to other seasons, targeted efficiency measures\n",
    "  (better scheduling, drip expansion) in Zaid could yield the biggest improvement.\n",
    "- **Crop-season matching:** Crops with a clear seasonal yield advantage (from the\n",
    "  crop x season heatmap) should be prioritized for that season in future planning.\n",
    "- **Further investigation:** State-level deviations from the general seasonal trend\n",
    "  warrant deeper, localized analysis (soil type, micro-climate, irrigation\n",
    "  infrastructure) beyond the scope of this dataset.\n",
    "\n",

    "*End of analysis.*\n"
